name: Do I need permits for accessibility renovations in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for accessibility renovations in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many accessibility renovations, especially those involving structural changes, plumbing, or electrical work, typically require permits in Bay Area cities like Pacifica, Daly City, or San Mateo. Minor modifications like installing grab bars usually do not. We can help identify which aspects of your project require permits and assist with the application process to ensure all work complies with local building codes and regulations.
